_comment: Source of truth for the Google Workspace Marketplace SDK listing and the OAuth consent screen. Nothing here is applied automatically -- Google exposes no write API for either -- but a human pastes from this file (see marketplace/RUNBOOK.md), and tools/check-listing.sh keeps it consistent with src/appsscript.json, deployment.json, and the assets it references.

app.name: Polyglot Slides
app.shortDescription: Translate any selection, slide, or whole deck into several languages with one click.

deployment._comment: The Marketplace SDK 'Editor add-on' field takes an Apps Script deployment ID. Read it from deployment.json (tools/release.sh updates that deployment in place on every tagged release, so the listing never needs re-pointing).

oauth._comment: Must equal src/appsscript.json oauthScopes exactly; check-listing.sh fails otherwise. Both are non-sensitive scopes, so verification needs brand verification only (no security assessment).

assets._comment: Sizes are what the Marketplace SDK App Configuration / Store Listing and the OAuth consent screen ask for. Icons are rendered from icon.svg by tools/render-icons.sh. Screenshots are captured by hand (RUNBOOK step 7) at 1280x800 and listed in screenshots.json.

distribution._comment: Pick one before publishing. 'private' = visible only inside the publishing Workspace domain (no Google review; admins can install for everyone). 'unlisted' = Marketplace review + OAuth brand verification, installable by any Google account via the listing link.
